say:2:1241110002:1.text: I'm documenting the local customs and traditions of Rustport!
say:2:1241110002:1.source_cn: 在记录锈锚港的风土人情！

say:3:1241110003:1.text: Even though we're still in the Lightbearer Empire, being on the coast means all you can see here are endless blue waves. Not at all like Holistone, that's for certain.
say:3:1241110003:1.source_cn: 这里虽然也在耀光帝国境内，但位于大海之上，放眼望去只能...

choice_prompt:4:1241110003.text: Even though we're still in the Lightbearer Empire, being on the coast means all you can see here are endless blue waves. Not at all like Holistone, that's for certain.
choice_prompt:4:1241110003.source_cn: 这里虽然也在耀光帝国境内，但位于大海之上，放眼望去只能看到碧波万顷，和圣石镇那边完全不同呢。

say:5:1241110004:1.text: Classic Merlin; your keen eye is as sharp as ever.
say:5:1241110004:1.source_cn: 不愧是梅林，观察力还是一如既往的出众~
say:5:1241110004:1.male: Classic Merlin; your keen eye is as sharp as ever.
say:5:1241110004:1.female: Classic Merlin; your keen eye is as sharp as ever.

say:6:1241110005:1.text: The locals in Rustport are truly rugged; from what I've gathered, it's likely because the city was initially founded by a group of exiled sailors.
say:6:1241110005:1.source_cn: 锈锚港的本地居民的确性情剽悍，根据我了解到的历史，可能...

say:7:1241110006:1.text: Seafarers have always preferred heavily salted and oily foods. Coupled with Rustport's humid climate, this preference has persisted to the present day.
say:7:1241110006:1.source_cn: 漂泊在大海上的水手，本来就偏好重盐重油的食物。再加上锈...

say:8:1241110007:1.text: Now that you mention it, the food in Rustport is really intense... but Chippy likes it!
say:8:1241110007:1.source_cn: 这么说起来，锈锚港的食物确实味道很重。不过满满喜欢！

say:9:1241110008:1.text: Hmm, if you stayed here for a year or so, you might not feel that way anymore...
say:9:1241110008:1.source_cn: 唔，如果让你在这里待上一年半载，你可能就不会这样觉得了……

say:12:1241110010:1.text: That's right, with so few farmlands near Rustport, seafood is basically all there is.
say:12:1241110010:1.source_cn: 是呀，锈锚港附近的农田不多，平时能吃到的食物几乎都是鱼...

say:13:1241110011:1.text: And with the blockade, anything but fish is incredibly costly. Fruits and vegetables are especially expensive!
say:13:1241110011:1.source_cn: 尤其是港口被封锁的这段时间，要想不吃鱼，可是要花很多钱...

say:14:1241110012:1.text:
You haven't had any fruits or vegetables this entire time?!
This is just... dreadful!
say:14:1241110012:1.source_cn: 一直吃不到蔬菜和水果？！\n这……这也太可怕了！

say:15:1241110013:1.text: Maybe for us, but the locals seemed to have adapted a long time ago.
say:15:1241110013:1.source_cn: 是呀，对我们来说，真的很可怕。不过本地人似乎早就习惯了。

say:16:1241110014:1.text: Also, instead of the Goddess Dura, many people here worship Tritonus, the god of the waves. Probably because Tritonus rules the sea and can provide bountiful catches for fishermen.
say:16:1241110014:1.source_cn: 对了，比起艾雅女神，这里也有不少人信仰风浪与漂泊之神特...

say:17:1241110015:1.text: I've also seen fishermen release their first catch each day back into the sea as an offering to the god of the waves.
say:17:1241110015:1.source_cn: 我还见到有渔民将每天钓到的第一尾鱼放回溪流和大海，当做...

say:18:1241110016:1.text: Well... what else would a common fisherman offer?
say:18:1241110016:1.source_cn: 唔……毕竟除了鱼以外，普通的渔民可能也没什么东西能献给...

say:19:1241110017:1.text: You think the god of waves would take gold coins?
say:19:1241110017:1.source_cn: 你说，他会接受金币作为供奉吗？

say:21:1241110018:1.text: Hey now, did I just hear "gold"? Any tips for making it rich?
say:21:1241110018:1.source_cn: 嘿，嘿，朋友们，我听到有人在聊钱？有发财的路数吗？

say:22:1241110019:0.text: ...One thing we know for sure is that Tritonus isn't as greedy as Sinbad!
say:22:1241110019:0.source_cn: ……至少我们可以肯定，特勒米琉斯不会像辛巴达一样贪财！

choice:11:0:1.text: Because all you'd have is seafood!
choice:11:0:1.male: Because all you'd have is seafood!
choice:11:0:1.female: Because all you'd have is seafood!

choice:11:1:2.text: Even fruit is hard to come by...
choice:11:1:2.male: Even fruit is hard to come by...
choice:11:1:2.female: Even fruit is hard to come by...

choice:4:1:2.text: Indeed, the people here are hardy.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 没错，这里的人特别剽悍
choice:4:1:2.male: Indeed, the people here are hardy.
choice:4:1:2.female: Indeed, the people here are hardy.
